data.title: Replace Fractal NYC software-post screenshots with per-page entrance video clips

data.body: Reviewed diff on branch feature/ASMV-109-fractal-entrance-clips (PR #109, based on clean origin/main). works.json change is isolated to the fractal-nyc screenshots array; all 5 referenced .mp4s (visit/events/campus/education/publications) are present in the commit; no dangling fractal-nyc .png refs remain; LabMedia auto-renders .mp4 as looping muted video so no component change needed. All 6 clips (incl. dropped home) were visually approved by Julianna locally before commit, and each was frame-checked to confirm the entrance animation is on-camera and the scroll stops above the footer. Note: low-complexity, human-approved asset swap — self-reviewed rather than via a separate cold sub-agent. Meets acceptance criteria.
